cohort: 1787 women who underwent cesarean section in two hospitals in Shiraz, Iran in 2018
finding: The highest frequency of cesarean sections (46.6%) was observed in Robson's classification group 5 (previous cesarean section) followed by group 2 (nulliparous women).
mod_finding: The study found a high prevalence of cesarean section in women with previous cesarean section (Robson's group 5) and nulliparous women (Robson's group 2).
